# MedlinePlus

> MedlinePlus is a free, authoritative health information resource from the National Library of Medicine providing trusted medical information on diseases, drugs, tests, and wellness.

MedlinePlus serves as a comprehensive consumer health portal operated by the National Library of Medicine (part of the NIH), offering evidence-based health information in multiple languages and formats. The site integrates with electronic health records through MedlinePlus Connect and provides specialized resources for genetic conditions, clinical trials, and health literacy.

## Key Topics

- Health Information
- Medical Tests & Diagnostics
- Drug & Supplement Information
- Genetic Conditions
- Health Topics Directory
- Medical Encyclopedia
- Patient Education
- Wellness Resources
- Clinical Trials
- MedlinePlus Connect (EHR Integration)
- Multilingual Health Information
- Easy-to-Read Materials
- National Library of Medicine
- NIH Resources
- Healthy Sleep

## Core Health Information

- [MedlinePlus - Health Information from the National Library of Medicine](https://medlineplus.gov): MedlinePlus homepage: trusted health information from NIH and NLM
- [Health Topics: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/healthtopics.html): Directory of 1000+ diseases, conditions, and wellness topics
- [Medical Encyclopedia: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/encyclopedia.html): A.D.A.M. Medical Encyclopedia with articles on diseases and procedures
- [MedlinePlus: About MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/about): About MedlinePlus: mission, service description, and NLM overview

## Medical Reference & Testing

- [Drugs, Herbs and Supplements: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/druginformation.html): Drug, herb, and supplement information with interactions and dosages
- [MedlinePlus: Medical Tests](https://medlineplus.gov/lab-tests): Directory of medical tests, lab procedures, and diagnostic information
- [MedlinePlus: Genetics](https://medlineplus.gov/genetics): Genetic conditions, genes, chromosomes, and DNA information

## Specialized Services & Integration

- [MedlinePlus: MedlinePlus Connect](https://medlineplus.gov/medlineplus-connect): MedlinePlus Connect: EHR integration service linking to health info
- [Health Information for All of Us Research Program Participants](https://medlineplus.gov/allofus.html): Health information for NIH All of Us research program participants
- [NIH MedlinePlus Magazine](https://magazine.medlineplus.gov): NIH MedlinePlus Magazine with health news and wellness articles

## Accessibility & Multilingual Resources

- [Easy-to-Read Health Information: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/all_easytoread.html): Easy-to-read health materials for limited health literacy
- [Health Information in Multiple Languages: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/languages/languages.html): Health information directory in multiple languages
- [MedlinePlus - Información de Salud de la Biblioteca Nacional de Medicina](https://medlineplus.gov/spanish): Spanish-language health information from National Library of Medicine
- [MedlinePlus: Accessibility](https://medlineplus.gov/accessibility.html): Web accessibility features and adaptive equipment information

## Wellness & Lifestyle

- [Healthy Sleep | MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/healthysleep.html): Sleep basics, hygiene, stages, and health information guide
- [MedlinePlus: Healthy Recipes](https://medlineplus.gov/recipes): Healthy recipes and meal planning with nutritional guidelines

## Updates & Feeds

- [What's New on MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/whatsnew): Updates, announcements, and new content on MedlinePlus
- [RSS Feeds: MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/rss.html): RSS feed subscriptions for MedlinePlus health topics

## Optional

- [MedlinePlus: Linking to and Using Content from MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/about/using/usingcontent): Content licensing, copyright policy, and linking guidelines
